description.e: Standalone Python 3 helper and QML console for FTDI/OpenDMX, uDMX 16c0:05dc and multi-universe Art-Net/sACN. Generic LED Par/Bar and Beam/Wash/Spot/3-in-1 profiles, BPM Circle/8-Figure/Pan-Tilt Sweep, smoke level/interval/duration/momentary flash and 2D preview. Start the helper explicitly. summary.e: Map external USB MIDI controllers (Pioneer CDJ-400 first) to internal Deck 3/4.

description.s: 低优先级 (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper 与 60 Hz QML 桥接，绕过 Engine KnownDevices SysEx 门禁，将外部 USB MIDI 控制器直接映射到四轨模式下的内部 Deck 3/4，无需切换硬件 Layer。含 CDJ-400 连续速度转盘积分器 (64=停止)、带 ▲▼ 指示的 Pitch 软接管、热拔插与 MIDI 风暴自动停用保护。CDJ-400 标准 USB MIDI 模式不接收外部 Note/CC LED 回传，状态与 ▲▼ 指示显示在屏幕上。
description.t: 低優先級 (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper 與 60 Hz QML 橋接，繞過 Engine KnownDevices SysEx 門禁，將外部 USB MIDI 控制器直接映射至四軌模式下的內部 Deck 3/4，無須切換硬體 Layer。含 CDJ-400 連續速度轉盤積分器 (64=停止)、帶 ▲▼ 指示的 Pitch 軟接管、熱拔插與 MIDI 風暴自動停用保護。CDJ-400 標準 USB MIDI 模式不接收外部 Note/CC LED 回傳，狀態與 ▲▼ 指示顯示於螢幕上。
description.e: Low-priority (nice 19) ALSA Sequencer helper and 60 Hz QML bridge mapping external USB MIDI controllers directly to internal Deck 3/4 in 4-deck mode without switching hardware layers. Includes CDJ-400 continuous velocity jog time-integration (64=stop), tempo slider soft takeover with ▲▼ indicators, and hot-unplug/storm auto-disable. CDJ-400 in standard USB MIDI mode does not accept external MIDI Note/CC LED feedback; status and ▲▼ indicators are shown on screen.
